en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide street bordered on the left by a long multi‑story brick building with shopfronts and awnings, with horse‑drawn carts and pedestrians in the dirt roadway. On the right side is a tree‑lined fence and sidewalk receding into the distance. Russian text at the top identifies the scene as Omsk and mentions Dvortsovaya Street and the Zaitseva Hotel.
